environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) with direct internet exposure via Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy, no CDN, no WAF. The application serves uploaded files directly via express.static with default MIME type handling. Node.js v18.x with default configuration.

config.network: EC2 security group ingress: TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0
